workload: Korean explanation of inference latency with varied reference notes
input_scope: Synthetic exact Qwen token lengths. 25K approximates the earlier gpchan size estimate; it is not a replay of the gpchan system prompt/tools.
eos_scope: Unreachable EOS id forces exactly 512 tokens, including any natural end-of-turn followed by continuation. Record natural EOS positions; not an answer-quality evaluation.

timers.internal_prompt_ms: DONE.prompt_ms: engine r0 to prompt completion after expert-cache refill, including reset, target prefill and draft KV prefill. Last input token is processed by first verify window.
timers.internal_prefill_tps: (input_tokens - 1) / (DONE.prompt_ms / 1000), after verifying zero reused tokens and final PP position=input_tokens-1.
timers.last_pp_ms: Cumulative engine r0-to-last-prefill-chunk timer; includes target and draft prefill. Excludes subsequent cache refill; not a pure target kernel timer.
timers.internal_decode_ms: DONE.decode_ms: first verify window (last prompt token and first output), subsequent verify/draft windows, completion bookkeeping.
timers.ttft_seconds: IPC client time immediately before GEN serialization/write to first received token; excludes model startup, includes prefill/first generation/IPC.
timers.stream_decode_tps: 511 / (last_token_received - first_token_received); tokens accepted together arrive in bursts.
timers.elapsed_seconds: IPC client time immediately before GEN serialization/write to DONE receipt; excludes model startup.

limitations: One explanation prompt per length; A-B-B-A engine order controls drift but loads remain few.
Existing dynamic governors; NVMe APST off and 2 s I/O timeout.
hypothesis: The fork's MMQ prompt path (mul_mat_q, 40% of 25K prefill) decodes TQ2_T tiles with codebook reads from global memory (tq_lane_to_q8). Staging the int8 codebook in shared memory at mul_mat_q start (patches/agention-llama-tq-mmq-shared-lut.patch, on top of the adopted strata-orin-tq2t-stage-lut.patch) should shorten prefill with token-identical output. a = current serving build (build-sm87-tq2t-prefetch, strata 1d62562c), b = build-sm87-mmq-lut; engine starts alternate A-B-B-A.
decision_metrics: internal prefill tok/s and TTFT b vs a at 25K and 2K
chunk_scope: All modes use --no-prefill-borrow --prefill 8192. Later --spec / --spec-min-p in mode_args override the protocol values (last flag wins in the engine parser).
